purpose: Exploratory test of one H2-supported host split in the canonical C alignment
constraint_semantics: The four host-side tips are separated from the other 100 C tips; every other relationship is unresolved. All 104 tips are retained because the two focal splits become compatible if projected to only the six named candidate hosts.
negative_controls: No independent BGC-negative controls validated; the other C tips provide phylogenetic context, not negative controls.
stop_rule: Do not run AU if constrained and unconstrained trees have different taxon sets or if the constrained tree lacks the specified four-tip split. Do not make an HGT event call from an AU result.
readiness_gate: Do not interpret AU before C model sensitivity and orthology/context review; AU tests topology conditional on alignment/model, not transfer.
